payload.friendly_name: Service tests wait for states; test hooks out of main
payload.purpose_context: Actions 8 and 9 of the 2026-11-25 codebase-health summary (ADR-0075 AA5): vacuous passes on a loaded runner and global state across parallel tests. Retrofit: the code was written as an Op on test/659-state-waits-and-main-hooks before this Mission existed; the Mission specifies, reviews and lands it.
payload.purpose_tldr: Make the service tests reliable: state waits instead of sleeps, and no static counters, JobGate or test-only constructors in main code (#659).

options: keep + ADR-0075 AA5 amendment + move out of packs.domain (recommended)
give it a production consumer (per-request read-work metrics)
payload.question: Q5: The six static counters are replaced by WorkMeter, a ScopedValue-bound meter only tests call. Keep it on purpose (ADR-0075 AA5 amendment) and move it out of packs.domain, give it a production consumer, or something else?

Q6: Bring the F12 test-only methods into scope (CompositionFactsCache.loads/hits, RegistrationJobs.retained, ClosureQueries.allConfigured; keep RegistryWriteLock.hasQueuedThread and PackCommitStore.SwapPhases with a recorded reason)?
